Card Q&A.q: I play this card while DigiXrosing with 2 cards, but there are no cards with [Knightmon] in their name, [DeadlyAxemon], or [Nene Amano] among the cards revealed by the [On Play] effect.Does the "delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 4 or less" effect still activate?

Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] names.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon].")

Effect: The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon].

[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Knightmon] in its name, 1 [DeadlyAxemon], or 1 [Nene Amano] among them to your hand. Trash the rest. Then, if DigiXrosing with 2 cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 4 or less.
Special Play Condition: DigiXros -1: [SkullKnightmon] × [DeadlyAxemon] When you would play this card, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each placed card reduces the play cost.
